name: Sanctum Protocol
source:
After the cataclysm known as The Breach, portals opened to a dimension of corrupted pleasure, unleashing seductive female demons and monsters that shattered the balance of Earth.

Humanity’s last hope lies with the order of warrior nuns who fight against demons, remaining uncorrupted by pleasure through their faith.

You are a young civilian who, after an encounter with a succubus, awakens the forbidden power of the Guardian: the ability to purify demons through the body. 

Guide the Order of the White Spear down the Sacred Path, or follow the Corrupt Path.
